blocks.content: In Advanced mode, you choose which query or expression determines when the alert fires. Unlike Default mode (which uses the **When** input), Advanced mode lets you set the alert condition on any row in the pipeline.
To set the alert condition, complete the following steps:

Find the query or expression row you want to use as the alert condition. Typically, this is the last expression in the pipeline—the one that produces the final computed result.

Click **Set as alert condition** on that row. A badge appears confirming the selection.

| Row type | When to use as condition |
|----------|-------------------------|
| Threshold expression | When you want a simple above/below comparison |
| Math expression | When you need cross-query logic (e.g., `$A > $B`) |
| Reduce expression | When a single aggregated value is sufficient |
Click **Preview** to test the alert condition against current data. The preview shows which series would currently fire based on your threshold and recovery settings.
The alert condition is set. In the next milestone, you'll configure evaluation behavior, notifications, and save the rule.
